description: This file declares the class OpenCDMSessionPrivate, which manages CDM sessions, including license handling, key management, and session lifecycle for a media DRM system. It includes method declarations for license requests, session updates, key status checks, and protection metadata handling.

classes.name: OpenCDMSessionPrivate
classes.description: A class implementing a private CDM session, handling license requests, key management, and session lifecycle for media decryption.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request events, sending license request messages to the license server.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal events, updating the license data.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Updates internal key status information when key statuses change.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request based on init data and CDM data.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with license data.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key with the given ID exists.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the status of a key.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Returns the last DRM error code.
